research.title: Spectrum Management, Millimeter-Wave Integration, Energy Efficiency, and Cooperative CSI Feedback in D2D-Enabled 5G Massive MIMO Networks
research.description: This thesis investigates hybrid mmWave/microwave switching strategies, energy efficiency optimizations, and cooperative D2D-assisted CSI feedback mechanisms to enhance coverage and performance in 5G massive MIMO networks.

research.title: Stochastic Modeling and Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Server Allocation in Industrial SCADA Networks
research.description: This thesis develops a unified stochastic framework using Continuous-Time Markov Chains and M/M/c/K queueing models to analyze network congestion, and applies Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) via Proximal Policy Optimization to achieve real-time, adaptive server allocation in industrial SCADA systems.

publications.title: A Distributed Method Analysis for Enabling Device-to-Device Communications in Millimeter Wave Bands
publications.venue: 2019 International Conference on Computer, Communication, Chemical, Materials and Electronic Engineering (IC4ME2)
publications.abstract: This research evaluates the SINR coverage probability of a distributed D2D method that dynamically switches between mmWave and microwave bands based on line-of-sight availability, outperforming standalone deployments.

publications.title: Investigation of Energy Efficiency in Underlaid D2D Assisted 5G Cellular Network
publications.venue: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
publications.abstract: This study evaluates how various network parameters and operational criteria impact the energy efficiency of multi-band cellular networks underlaid with D2D communications.

publications.title: Evaluation of Feedback Method for FDD Massive MIMO in Device-to-device Communications
publications.venue: 2019 3rd International Conference on Electrical, Computer & Telecommunication Engineering (ICECTE)
publications.abstract: This research evaluates a cooperative CSI feedback scheme utilizing D2D communication for FDD massive MIMO systems, demonstrating superior sum-rate performance and reduced delay compared to conventional feedback methods.

publications.title: Congestion-Coupled Communication Delay Modeling in High-Density Textile SCADA Networks: A Continuous-Time Markov Chain and M/M/c/K Queueing Analysis
publications.abstract: This study develops a stochastic framework utilizing a three-state Continuous-Time Markov Chain and an M/M/c/K queueing model to analyze task arrivals and model non-linear communication delays under high-density textile SCADA network congestion.

publications.title: Proximal Policy Optimization for Adaptive Server Allocation in Stochastic Industrial SCADA Systems: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Textile Manufacturing
publications.abstract: This study formulates industrial server allocation as a Markov Decision Process and applies a Proximal Policy Optimization deep reinforcement learning agent to dynamically optimize active servers, thereby minimizing latency and service level violations.
